about.text: Gomme is a traditional Norwegian dish usually served as a spread or a dessert. Gomme has long traditions in several places in the country and was largely used as a party food when cakes were served, for example at Christmas.

how.text: Brown gomme boils the whey in with the curd; white gomme (hvitgomme) separates the curd from the whey and boils it down with cream. Dravle is a district name for gomme that means other things elsewhere, one of them a whey-protein dish.
